messages:
Sam Patel: quick heads-up — the API ref example for POST /v1/users:update mixes types for user_id (int vs string), causing our TS SDK snippet to be wrong.
Asha Nguyen: ah that's annoying. do you have the snippet?
Sam Patel: ```curl
POST /v1/users:update
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "user_id": 12345,
  "profile": { "display_name": "sam" }
}
```
Ben Ortiz: yep, SDK expects string id: users.update({ userId: 'user_12345' })
Ben Ortiz: i'll open a tiny docs PR to change the example to a string id and add a note about legacy numeric ids.
Sam Patel: can you also add the corresponding TS and Python snippets? The python one currently does int too.
Ben Ortiz: sure. will add both and a unit example showing both forms.
docs-bot: PR created — #4521 ben/docs/fix-user-id-example
Asha Nguyen: i'll review later today. if this is just docs-only, no eng-api change needed; but flag me if schema needs update
Ben Ortiz: PR pushed. changed body to {"user_id": "user_12345"}, updated TS/Python, added migration note under docs/migrations/user-ids.md
Asha Nguyen: LGTM — left 1 nit about wording, but overall good. i'll merge after CI passes :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: thanks both. after merge can someone backport to v1.2 branch and update the changelog entry? small blurb: "Clarify user_id type in users:update examples (string preferred)."
Ben Ortiz: will backport and add changelog.
Asha Nguyen: merged and backported. changelog link: https://go.redwood/changelog/2026-03-21
Sam Patel: awesome — closing this thread. :tada:
